directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: What's up?
entries.JA_current: What's up?
entries.JA_new: どうした？

entries.EN: Hey, man! You want to make some money? I need mutant parts.
entries.JA_current: Hey, man! You want to make some money? I need mutant parts.
entries.JA_new: なあ、金を稼がないか？ ミュータントの部位が欲しいんだ。

entries.EN: What will you give me for them?
entries.JA_current: What will you give me for them?
entries.JA_new: いくらで買ってくれる？

entries.EN:
I'll pay for them in loot. I have a contract with the scientists to supply samples. If you shoot anything, give it to me. I'll pay you properly. I can usually give you artifacts, but if I'm out of those, then it will be ammunition and health supplies? So, do you have anything to trade? 
		\n \n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Dog Tail (x4): %c[0,170,170,170]Jellyfish\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Cat Tail (x3): %c[0,170,170,170]Wrenched\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Pseudodog Tail: %c[0,170,170,170]Stone Blood\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Flesh Eye: %c[0,170,170,170]Droplet\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Boar Hoof (x2): %c[0,170,170,170]Thorn\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Tushkano Head (x2): %c[0,170,170,170]Antirad (x3)\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Snork Foot: %c[0,170,170,170]Slime\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Zombie Hand (x4): %c[0,170,170,170]Vodka, Vinca, Bandage\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Fracture Arm (x2):  %c[0,170,170,170]Rifled Slug (x2), Shotgun Slugs\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Burer Paw: %c[0,170,170,170]Fireball\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Controller Hand: %c[0,170,170,170]Meat Chunk\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Poltergeist Eye: %c[0,170,170,170]Slug\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Bloodsucker Tentacles: %c[0,170,170,170]Crystal Thorn\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Chimer Claw (x2): %c[0,170,170,170]Stone Flower\n
		%c[0,0,255,255] • %c[0,255,255,255]Pseudogiant Paw: %c[0,170,170,170]Flash

entries.EN: I have blind dog tails.
entries.JA_current: I have blind dog tails.
entries.JA_new: ブラインドドッグの尻尾ならある。

entries.EN: I have wild cat tails.
entries.JA_current: I have wild cat tails.
entries.JA_new: バユンの尻尾ならある。

entries.EN: I have pseudodog tails.
entries.JA_current: I have pseudodog tails.
entries.JA_new: シュードドッグの尻尾ならある。

entries.EN: I have Flesh eyes.
entries.JA_current: I have Flesh eyes.
entries.JA_new: フレッシュの目ならある。

entries.EN: I have boar hooves.
entries.JA_current: I have boar hooves.
entries.JA_new: ボアの蹄がある。

entries.EN: I got a snork foot.
entries.JA_current: I got a snork foot.
entries.JA_new: スノークの足だ。

entries.EN: Tushkano heads, take them away.
entries.JA_current: Tushkano heads, take them away.
entries.JA_new: トゥシュカーノの頭だ。持ってってくれ。

entries.EN: Couple of Burer paws here, take them.
entries.JA_current: Couple of Burer paws here, take them.
entries.JA_new: ブーラーの手が二つある。受け取れ。

entries.EN: A Chimera's claws. Perfect for a talisman.
entries.JA_current: A Chimera's claws. Perfect for a talisman.
entries.JA_new: キメラの爪だ。お守りにぴったりだろ。

entries.EN: A controller's hand. Take this opportunity to cherish this rarity.
entries.JA_current: A controller's hand. Take this opportunity to cherish this rarity.
entries.JA_new: コントローラーの手だ。こんな珍しい品、今のうちに手に入れておけ。

entries.EN: The paw of a pseudo-giant. You've probably never seen such a thing.
entries.JA_current: The paw of a pseudo-giant. You've probably never seen such a thing.
entries.JA_new: シュードジャイアントの前足だ。こんなもの見たことないだろ。

entries.EN: A bloodsucker's feelers, here you go.
entries.JA_current: A bloodsucker's feelers, here you go.
entries.JA_new: ブラッドサッカーの触手だ。ほらよ。

entries.EN: Got a hold of an eye of a poltergeist.
entries.JA_current: Got a hold of an eye of a poltergeist.
entries.JA_new: ポルターガイストの目を手に入れた。

entries.EN: Got a few zombie hands here, will that do?
entries.JA_current: Got a few zombie hands here, will that do?
entries.JA_new: ゾンビの手がいくつかある。これでいいか？

entries.EN: Hands of a Fracture. Take 'em.
entries.JA_current: Hands of a Fracture. Take 'em.
entries.JA_new: フラクチャーの腕だ。持ってけ。

entries.EN: A rat carcass. Need it?
entries.JA_current: A rat carcass. Need it?
entries.JA_new: ネズミの死骸だ。要るか？

entries.EN: I don't have that.
entries.JA_current: I don't have that.
entries.JA_new: それは持ってない。

entries.EN: Great, you get a Jellyfish for that:
entries.JA_current: Great, you get a Jellyfish for that:
entries.JA_new: よし、代わりにジェリーフィッシュをやる。

entries.EN: Here's a Twist for you:
entries.JA_current: Here's a Twist for you:
entries.JA_new: ほら、トゥイストだ。

entries.EN: I'll give you a Blood for a pseudo-dog's tail
entries.JA_current: I'll give you a Blood for a pseudo-dog's tail
entries.JA_new: シュードドッグの尻尾ならブラッドをやる。

entries.EN: Here's a Drops for that:
entries.JA_current: Here's a Drops for that:
entries.JA_new: ほら、ドロップレットだ。

entries.EN: For a boar's hoof you get a "Thorn"
entries.JA_current: For a boar's hoof you get a "Thorn"
entries.JA_new: ボアの蹄ならソーンだ。

entries.EN: Here's a "Slime" for it:
entries.JA_current: Here's a "Slime" for it:
entries.JA_new: その代わり、スライムをやろう。

entries.EN: I'll give you one Anti-Rad for a tushkan's head:
entries.JA_current: I'll give you one Anti-Rad for a tushkan's head:
entries.JA_new: トゥシュカーノの頭なら、抗放射線薬をやる。

entries.EN: A Burer's paw is a valuable trophy, take a "Fireball" for it:
entries.JA_current: A Burer's paw is a valuable trophy, take a "Fireball" for it:
entries.JA_new: ブーラーの手は貴重な戦利品だ。ファイアボールを持っていけ。

entries.EN: For him I will give the Stone Flower:
entries.JA_current: For him I will give the Stone Flower:
entries.JA_new: そいつと引き換えに、ストーンフラワーをやる。

entries.EN: Yes, a very valuable specimen. Take this piece.
entries.JA_current: Yes, a very valuable specimen. Take this piece.
entries.JA_new: そう、かなり貴重な標本だ。こいつを持ってけ。

entries.EN: Wow, what luck! Thank you, here's the artifact Flash as a reward:
entries.JA_current: Wow, what luck! Thank you, here's the artifact Flash as a reward:
entries.JA_new: こいつは運がいいな！ 礼を言うよ。報酬のフラッシュだ。

entries.EN: Was he a big guy? Did you do it yourself or did you have help? Take the crystal one.
entries.JA_current: Was he a big guy? Did you do it yourself or did you have help? Take the crystal one.
entries.JA_new: 大物だったか？ 一人で倒したのか、それとも仲間がいた？ クリスタルをやるよ。

entries.EN: Yes, it's a rare find. Here's a Slug for you:
entries.JA_current: Yes, it's a rare find. Here's a Slug for you:
entries.JA_new: 珍しいものを見つけたな。ほら、スラッグをやる。

entries.EN: Give it to me, here's the medicine as a reward:
entries.JA_current: Give it to me, here's the medicine as a reward:
entries.JA_new: そいつを渡してくれ。礼に薬をやるよ。

entries.EN: If it comes in handy, have some ammunition, a real hunter can always use it:
entries.JA_current: If it comes in handy, have some ammunition, a real hunter can always use it:
entries.JA_new: 役に立つなら弾薬を持っていけ。本物のハンターなら、弾はいくらあっても困らない。

entries.EN: Nah, you keep that stuff.
entries.JA_current: Nah, you keep that stuff.
entries.JA_new: いや、そいつは持ってろ。
